svg.text: G03 DUT4 NAND flip-flop: forward strengthened to nand2_4 (gate level)
clk low: the master door passes d into the master latch (mq). clk high: the door shuts, the master latch holds or resolves,
and the slave door copies mq to the slave latch, which drives q. A late clock edge can leave mq/mqb between 0 and 1 (metastable).
Each box is one cell (name, then cell type). Click a box and press e to see its transistors; Ctrl+e comes back. A dot marks a connection; wires that cross without a dot are not connected.
